units.text:
Quick update from my side.

Quick note on KW-153: the FAQ jumps on mobile when the cookie notice closes. It is a layout shift from the image without a height. I set width and height on the img tag and it is gone on my phone, but please check on an older Android if you have one around.

A longer thought on the header, because we keep going around in circles. The problem is not the design, it is that we try to say everything in one screen: the story, the taste, the farm, the recipes, the price, the reviews. People on phones scroll for about three screens and then either buy or leave. So my proposal: first screen is the product and the button, second is three short facts with small icons, third is reviews, and everything else goes behind "read more" links. Nell can keep her longer texts, they just move one click deeper. I made a quick prototype in Figma, the frame is called "product page – lean". If nobody hates it, I will turn it into a ticket, KW-112, and we try it on staging next week.

Дальше начинает тормозить корзина: она каждый раз пересчитывает доставку по всем странам. Поставил кэш на расчёт, после этого 200 пользователей держит спокойно, процессор на 60%. Для сравнения: в прошлогодний чёрный пятницу на старом сайте было максимум 40 человек одновременно, так что запас большой. Отчёт с графиками положил в папку с документацией, если кому интересно.

Плёнку для фотосессии привезли, но стол в студии слишком блестит, будут блики. Попросил у студии матовую подложку, обещали к понедельник. Если не дадут, возьму свою из дома, она серая.

Ретро коротко. Хорошо: ревью стали быстрее, стейджинг стабильный. Плохо: потеряли день на пайплайне картинок, две задачи были слишком большие. Пробуем: всё, что больше двух дней, режем, и по утрам в четверг пятиминутка вместо длинного стендапа.

Иконки перерисовал в одном стиле: линия 1,5px, скруглённые концы, сетка 24. Старые были из трёх разных наборов, это было видно на корзине. Экспорт в SVG, всё лежит в папке icons, имена файлов по-английски.

Немного про то, как мы работаем с макетами упаковки, чтобы не было путаницы с версиями. Рабочий файл один, в папке packaging, имя не меняем. Каждая версия, которая уходит клиенту, сохраняется в PDF с датой в имени в папку sent. Правки клиента собираем в один документ, а не в чат, потому что в чате их невозможно найти через неделю. Перед отправкой — проверка по чек-листу: вылеты, белила, шрифты в кривых, штрихкод читается телефоном, текст совпадает с утверждённым документом. Чек-лист лежит рядом с файлом. Если торопимся и пропускаем чек-лист — потом теряем больше.

По шрифтам: веб-лицензия покрывает 50 тысяч просмотров в месяц, нам хватит. Десктопная — на рабочее место, она только у меня и у Даша. Если кому-то надо открыть исходники, не ставьте триалку, словолитня за этим следит.

Цвета в коде и в Фигме разъехались: в Фигме зелёный #2F6B4F, в CSS был #2E6A4E. Свёл всё к токенам, теперь цвета берутся из одного файла. Если увидите где-то захардкоженный цвет — это баг, кидайте мне.

Lighthouse на корзине: производительность 91, доступность 96, SEO 92. SEO теряем на отсутствующих мета-описаниях на двух страницах, их пишет Нелл. Производительность в основном съедает виджет чата, его можно грузить лениво.

Сделал превью-ссылки на каждую ветку: у каждого пулл-реквеста свой адрес, появляется в описании минуты через четыре после сборки. Клиенту лучше слать их, а не стейджинг, стейджинг меняется слишком часто.

Кнопка «В корзину» на футере уезжает под сгиб, если описание длинное, — делаем её липкой внизу экрана. Переключатель вкусов работает, но его не видно: люди не понимают, что кружочки кликаются, нужна подпись. Футер нормальный. Шрифт основного текста 15px мелковат для наших покупателей, ставлю 16. Всё это в задаче KW-147, со скриншотами до и после.

Если что — пишите.

units.author: Ilya Sorokin
units.text:
Даша, отвечаю длинно, потому что тут сразу несколько вещей, которые влияют на задник.

Первое — состав. Лаборатория прислала финальный протокол по питательной ценности, цифры немного поменялись: соль на 100 г теперь 2,1 г, а не 2,4, потому что мы в феврале уменьшили посыпку на «Морской соли». Таблицу обновил в общей папке, файл «nutrition_v3». Йод пока не пишем никак, даже «источник йода», — юристы ещё не ответили, можно ли это вообще писать на снеке.

Второе — образцы плёнки. Нам привезли три вида, они лежат в камере влажности уже третью неделю, промежуточный результат нормальный, листы хрустят. Окончательный вывод будет после полного теста.

Теперь срок годности: на новый пакет ставим не больше 9 месяцев от даты фасовки. 12 месяцев лаборатория не подтвердила — на десятом месяце листы начинают терять хруст, поэтому 12 писать нельзя. Формулировка: «Лучше всего употребить до:» и дата, место под дату — на нижнем шве, мы её печатаем струйником при фасовке. Для жестяной банки, которую мы делаем для подарочных наборов, там другой расчёт, банке дают 18 месяцев, но это не про пакет. И отдельной строкой «после вскрытия съесть в течение 6 недель» — это просили покупатели.

Третье — штрихкоды остаются старые, EAN не меняем, вкусы те же.

units.author: Maren Holt
units.text:
Catching up on the open threads in one go, sorry for the wall of text.

Photos: I liked the second set much more than the first. The sheets on the dark slate look like a real product, the white background ones look like a pharmacy. Please go with the slate for the hero shots and keep white only for the marketplace listings, which require it.

Copy on the about page: Nell, the farm paragraph is lovely but too long, nobody will read four paragraphs about currents. Two short paragraphs and a photo of the lines in the water would do it. Keep the bit about the storm in 2023, people remember stories, not facts.

Prices on the marketplace: they want us to match the web price exactly, which is fine, but they take 15%, so only the bundles go there, not the single bags. Petra will set it up after the relaunch.

Trade fair: I booked the hotel for three nights, two rooms. If anyone from Saltglass wants to come, tell me this week, the fair hotel is almost full.

Petra asked again about adding the sesame one. I know she wants five, and Dasha's moodboard shows six bags, which looked great, but production cannot handle more right now. So, final: we launch with four flavours — Sea Salt, Chili Lime, Smoked Paprika and Wasabi. Sesame can be the first limited edition in autumn if the numbers are good.

Last thing: can someone send me the invoice schedule again? Our accountant changed and the new one cannot find it. She also asked for all invoices to include our VAT number in the header, the old ones did not, so please reissue March if that is not too much trouble. And one more: the call on Thursday — can we move it to 9:30? I have the bank at 11 and I do not want to rush either of them.

units.text:
A few things before I log off:

A longer thought on the cart, because we keep going around in circles. The problem is not the design, it is that we try to say everything in one screen: the story, the taste, the farm, the recipes, the price, the reviews. People on phones scroll for about three screens and then either buy or leave. So my proposal: first screen is the product and the button, second is three short facts with small icons, third is reviews, and everything else goes behind "read more" links. Nell can keep her longer texts, they just move one click deeper. I made a quick prototype in Figma, the frame is called "cart – lean". If nobody hates it, I will turn it into a ticket, KW-204, and we try it on staging next week.

Translations: Estonian strings are back from the translator, Finnish next week. A few keys were too long for the buttons, I marked them in the sheet in yellow. Please do not edit the sheet directly, add a comment, otherwise the import breaks.

Copy review round two is done. I accepted most of the edits, pushed back on two: "crispy" vs "crunchy" (we agreed crunchy everywhere) and the exclamation marks, which we said we would keep to one per page. Updated doc is in the shared folder.

I compressed the hero images again. WebP at quality 78 looks the same as 85 to me and is about 30% lighter. The contact form went from 1.9 MB to 1.2 MB. AVIF is smaller still, but the build time doubled, so I left it off for now.

Quick note on KW-204: the product page jumps on mobile when the cookie notice closes. It is a layout shift from the image without a height. I set width and height on the img tag and it is gone on my phone, but please check on an older Android if you have one around.

Summary of the user interviews that Tim ran last week, five people, all current customers. Everyone found the product they wanted within a minute, which is good. Three of five did not understand the difference between the single bag and the bundle until they reached the cart, because the bundle price is shown per bag on the listing and as a total in the cart. Two people looked for the ingredients and found them only after scrolling past the reviews. One person asked whether the bags are suitable for children, which we do not answer anywhere. Nobody used the search. Everybody liked the photos on the dark background. Recordings and my notes are in the research folder; the most useful clip is the third one, about eight minutes in.

Accessibility pass on the recipe page: contrast of the grey helper text was 3.9:1, I darkened it to pass AA. Focus outlines were missing on the round buttons, now they have a 2px ring. Screen reader reads the quantity stepper as "button button", that one still needs a proper label.

More tomorrow.

Длинно, извините.

Подробнее про то, как устроен импорт товаров, потому что он уже два раза ломался. Данные приходят из таблицы, которую ведёт Петра: название, описание на трёх языках, цена, вес, состав, фото. Скрипт раз в час забирает таблицу и обновляет товары. Ломалось оба раза одинаково: в таблице появлялась новая колонка или кто-то переименовывал старую, и скрипт молча пропускал поле. Теперь он проверяет заголовки и, если что-то не так, ничего не обновляет и пишет в этот чат. Просьба к Даша: колонки не переименовывать и не переставлять, новые добавлять только в конец. units.text:
Answers to the list Owen sent on Friday, numbered the same way so it is easy to follow.

1. Gift messages: yes, a free text field at checkout, 200 characters, printed on a small card by the warehouse. No gift wrapping, we do not have the space.

2. Store locator: a simple list of shops is enough for now. The chains change their stock lists every month, we cannot keep a map up to date.

3. Reviews: fine with the free app. If someone writes something rude, Petra handles it, not the agency.

4. Bank links: yes for all three Baltic countries, Finland can wait, Finnish customers use cards anyway.

5. Customer accounts: optional. Guest checkout must stay the default, and the account page only needs order history and addresses. No wish lists, no points, no birthday discounts — we can think about loyalty after the summer, not before.

6. The allergen and age confirmation step: Liisa will send the exact wording. Please make it a single tick box with a link to the full allergen list, not a pop-up. If people have to click through three screens to buy a bag of seaweed, they will not.

7. Order emails: plain and short, in the language of the shop the customer used. I do not want the long marketing blocks under the receipt that the template has. One line about the farm in the footer is enough, and the contact address should be Petra's team inbox, not mine.

8. Pay-later. I talked to two other founders who use it, and it does help on bigger baskets, gift sets especially. My answer is yes, but only if Splitty signs at 2.9% with no monthly fee. Their offer today is 3.4% plus €49 a month, which kills the margin on a €20 basket. If they have not moved by 25 April, we launch without pay-later and look again in the summer.

9. Newsletter pop-up: agree with Nell, not on phones.

10. Prices online: same as the shelf price in Estonia, no online discount at launch. A launch code for the newsletter list is fine, 10%, one use per customer.

11. Wholesale: the cafés keep ordering by email as now. A wholesale login on the new site would be nice one day, but it is not something we build for the relaunch, and please do not let it creep into the estimate.

12. Recipes: move them over as they are. Nell can rewrite them later, they bring traffic, so the old links must keep working.

I think that covers everything. If I missed a number from your list, it means I agree with your suggestion.

Всем привет.

По шрифтам: веб-лицензия покрывает 50 тысяч просмотров в месяц, нам хватит. Десктопная — на рабочее место, она только у меня и у Даша. Если кому-то надо открыть исходники, не ставьте триалку, словолитня за этим следит.

Про письма покупателям. Сейчас у нас пять писем: подтверждение заказа, оплата прошла, заказ отправлен, заказ доставлен и просьба оставить отзыв через неделю. Все на трёх языках, язык берётся из того, на какой версии сайта сделан заказ. Свёрстаны на тех же компонентах, что и сайт, в Gmail и Apple Mail выглядят хорошо, Outlook на десктопе ломает скругления — это нормально, не трогаем. Тексты писала Нелл, юристы смотрели только футер с реквизитами. Если хотите посмотреть живьём — сделайте тестовый заказ на стейджинге, письма приходят на ваш адрес.

Про отпуск: я с 2 по 6 июня отдыхаю, Даша — последнюю неделю апреля. Внесите свои даты в общий календарь, чтобы не получилось, что в день релиза никого нет на поддержке.

Дальше начинает тормозить корзина: она каждый раз пересчитывает доставку по всем странам. Поставил кэш на расчёт, после этого 200 пользователей держит спокойно, процессор на 60%. Для сравнения: в прошлогодний чёрный пятницу на старом сайте было максимум 40 человек одновременно, так что запас большой. Отчёт с графиками положил в папку с документацией, если кому интересно.

Thanks all.

Про нагрузочный тест. Гонял сценарий «открыть главную, открыть товар, положить в корзину, дойти до оплаты» с нарастанием до 200 одновременных пользователей. До 120 всё ровно, ответ меньше 300 мс. Дальше начинает тормозить корзина: она каждый раз пересчитывает доставку по всем странам. Поставил кэш на расчёт, после этого 200 пользователей держит спокойно, процессор на 60%. Для сравнения: в прошлогодний чёрный пятницу на старом сайте было максимум 40 человек одновременно, так что запас большой. Отчёт с графиками положил в папку с документацией, если кому интересно.

Стейджинг ночью перезагрузился, пока не знаю почему. По логам память медленно росла с двух ночи. Поставил алерт на 80%, нормально посмотрю в пятницу. Ничего не потерялось, база на отдельной машине.

Ревью доступности: контраст серого вспомогательного текста был 3,9:1, затемнил до AA. На круглых кнопках не было обводки фокуса, теперь кольцо 2px. Скринридер читает счётчик количества как «кнопка кнопка» — это ещё надо подписать.

Ревью дизайна мобильной версии, по пунктам. Шапка слишком высокая — съедает почти четверть экрана на маленьких телефонах, предлагаю уменьшить логотип и убрать строку с телефоном в меню. Кнопка «В корзину» на шапке уезжает под сгиб, если описание длинное, — делаем её липкой внизу экрана. Переключатель вкусов работает, но его не видно: люди не понимают, что кружочки кликаются, нужна подпись. Футер нормальный. Шрифт основного текста 15px мелковат для наших покупателей, ставлю 16. Всё это в задаче KW-166, со скриншотами до и после.

Спасибо!

units.author: Ilya
units.text: Lighthouse на странице рецептов: производительность 91, доступность 96, SEO 92. SEO теряем на отсутствующих мета-описаниях на двух страницах, их пишет Нелл. Производительность в основном съедает виджет чата, его можно грузить лениво.

units.author: Alex Moreau
units.text:
Status, in no particular order:

Accessibility pass on the product page: contrast of the grey helper text was 3.9:1, I darkened it to pass AA. Focus outlines were missing on the round buttons, now they have a 2px ring. Screen reader reads the quantity stepper as "button button", that one still needs a proper label.

Error tracking caught 5 errors overnight, all the same one: a null price on a product with no variant selected. It only happens if you open the product page from an old link. I added a guard and a redirect to the default variant.

units.author: Petra
units.text: on it

units.author: Alex Moreau
units.text:
A few things before I log off:

I compressed the hero images again. WebP at quality 78 looks the same as 85 to me and is about 30% lighter. The header went from 1.9 MB to 1.2 MB. AVIF is smaller still, but the build time doubled, so I left it off for now.

Meeting notes from the call with the translator: they need final copy by the 20th of each month for the batch rate, otherwise it is a rush fee. They also asked for screenshots, not only strings, because context matters for Estonian word order.

Error tracking caught 4 errors overnight, all the same one: a null price on a product with no variant selected. It only happens if you open the footer from an old link. I added a guard and a redirect to the default variant.

About the Estonian and Finnish texts on the site: the translator is good but she does not see the layout, so some strings are much longer than the English ones and break the buttons. Instead of shortening them blindly, I would like the translator to get preview links for every page, with a note of the maximum length per field. That costs us maybe an hour per language to prepare, and saves the back-and-forth we had last month, when the Finnish checkout button said something like "proceed to the confirmation of the order" in three lines. Also, for the legal texts we should not use her at all, Liisa's office has their own translator and those texts must match the Estonian original word for word.

Accessibility pass on the about page: contrast of the grey helper text was 3.9:1, I darkened it to pass AA. Focus outlines were missing on the round buttons, now they have a 2px ring. Screen reader reads the quantity stepper as "button button", that one still needs a proper label.

Dependency updates are in KW-140. Mostly minor versions, one major for the image library, which changed the default quality. I pinned it to the old value so nothing looks different. Tests pass, but give the product page a quick look before we merge.

Security note: please turn on two-factor login on the shared accounts, the design tool and the hosting dashboard both support it. I will remove anyone without it from the hosting team on Wednesday, nothing personal.

The CMS editors asked for a preview button that shows the page as it will look on a phone. It is a small change in the admin, maybe half a day. I put it in KW-118 with low priority, it would help Ilya a lot when writing.

Reminder on how we handle bugs during the last weeks before launch, because the board is getting messy. Every bug gets a ticket, even small ones, with a screenshot and the device. Severity: blocker means a customer cannot buy, high means a customer sees something wrong, everything else is low. Blockers get fixed the same day, high within two days, low after launch unless it is a two-minute fix. Please do not report bugs only in this chat, they get lost. And please do not fix things that are not in a ticket, even if it is tempting, because then QA does not know what to retest. Owen triages the board every morning at ten.

That is all for now.

units.text:
Catching up after the call —

The staging server restarted during the night, no idea why yet. Logs show the memory going up slowly from about 2am. I added an alert at 80% and will look at it properly on Monday. Nothing is lost, the database is on a separate box.

Tasting session feedback from the team: the crunch is better than the old batch, people liked the colour of the new bags on the table, and two people said the font on the back is too small to read without glasses. I passed the last point to Dasha.

For the trade fair in Helsinki we need 14 sample boxes and the roll-up banner. The banner file is the old one with the old logo, Dasha will update it. The booth is 3 by 2 metres, no power socket unless we pay extra, so bring charged tablets.

Shout if anything is unclear.

units.text:
Доброе утро.

По шрифтам: веб-лицензия покрывает 50 тысяч просмотров в месяц, нам хватит. Десктопная — на рабочее место, она только у меня и у Илья. Если кому-то надо открыть исходники, не ставьте триалку, словолитня за этим следит.

Сделал шаблоны для соцсетей: квадрат 1080 для ленты, 1080 на 1920 для сторис и широкий для блога. Безопасные зоны отмечены. Логотип не кропайте, пожалуйста, берите шаблоны.

Lighthouse на карточке товара: производительность 91, доступность 96, SEO 92. SEO теряем на отсутствующих мета-описаниях на двух страницах, их пишет Нелл. Производительность в основном съедает виджет чата, его можно грузить лениво.

units.text: Обновил зависимости в KW-112. В основном минорные версии, одна мажорная у библиотеки картинок — там поменялось качество по умолчанию, я зафиксировал старое значение. Тесты проходят, но гляньте FAQ перед мёржем.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text:
Kelpwise has sold seaweed snacks since 2019, first at farmers markets around Tallinn, then through two regional supermarket chains and a small web shop built on a template in 2020. The snacks are roasted sheets of kelp and sugar kelp grown on a partner farm off Saaremaa, seasoned in the Saue kitchen and packed by hand. Sales grew about 40% a year until 2025, when growth stopped: the old packaging looks homemade next to the imported brands, the web shop converts poorly on phones, and the brand story (local, ocean-grown, low impact) is not visible on the shelf at all.

The relaunch has two parts that ship together: new packaging for the whole range, and a new web shop. Saltglass Studio leads design, copy and the shop build. Kelpwise owns production, suppliers, legal review of claims and fulfilment. The two teams share one chat for decisions; anything decided in a call is written there the same day.

What we are not changing: the recipe, the farm partner, the name. What we are free to change: everything on the pack, the pack format itself, the shop platform, prices online, and the tone of voice. The founders want the brand to feel calm and confident, not cute. No cartoon fish.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text: Three measurable goals for the first six months after launch: online conversion on mobile from 0.9% to 2%, repeat purchase within 90 days for 25% of web customers, and listing in at least one national chain in Finland. A softer goal: the pack should be recognisable from three metres on a crowded shelf.

units.author: Nell Okafor
units.text:
Primary: urban adults 25–45 who already buy healthy snacks, read labels, and care where food comes from. They shop in supermarkets during the week and order online for bulk or gifts. They are suspicious of big health claims and respond to plain facts (where it grows, what is in it, how much salt).

Secondary: gift buyers around Christmas and midsummer, and cafés that resell single bags at the counter. Cafés need a smaller pack and a display box, which is out of scope for this phase but should not be blocked by the design.

Interviews with twelve existing customers (notes in the research folder) gave a consistent picture: they love the taste, find the current bag hard to reseal, do not know the product is local, and would buy more often online if delivery were cheaper or bundled. Three people mentioned that they eat a whole bag at once, so resealing matters less to them than portion size. Two asked for a bigger family bag. Nobody asked for new flavours, but several were curious about a spicy one.

Tone for this audience: short sentences, concrete facts, a little dry humour. Avoid "superfood", "detox", "guilt-free". English and Estonian on pack; Finnish added for the Finnish chain.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text: Core range at relaunch: four flavours. Two limited editions may follow in autumn, not part of this brief. Bag size stays 25 g for sheets; the 60 g snack bites are discontinued with the relaunch.

units.author: Dasha Belova
units.text: Stand-up pouch with a zip and a small window showing the sheets. Matte finish, one spot green plus CMYK. Front: logo, flavour band, window, one claim at most. Back: story, ingredients, nutrition, recycling mark.

units.author: Ilya Sorokin
units.text: Preference for a compostable film; supplier to be chosen after samples. Fallback is a recyclable mono-material laminate. Whatever we choose must keep the sheets crisp at 75% humidity.

units.author: Ilya Sorokin
units.text: Best-before on the current bag is 12 months. For the new film: 12 months — to be confirmed by the lab after the storage test.

units.author: Ilya Sorokin
units.text: Shortlist for the print run: Vellprint (Tartu), Nordflex (Riga), Baltic Pouch Works (Vilnius). Quotes requested for 40,000 units with one reorder of 20,000. Decision by mid-March.

units.author: Kostya Rybin
units.text:
Platform: Shopwell, Grow plan, as agreed on 10 March. Reasons: hosted, quick to start, built-in tax handling for the EU, a theme engine Kostya knows. Known limits: checkout customisation is restricted to the Plus plan, and apps add monthly costs.

The current shop (template site from 2020) stays up until the switch. Product data, customer accounts and order history move over; passwords cannot be moved, so customers get a reset email on the first login. Redirects for all old product URLs are required, the old site has decent search traffic on the recipe posts.

Integrations needed at launch: payments, the warehouse order feed, newsletter sign-up, reviews. Nice to have: gift messages, a store locator for the supermarket chains.

units.author: Petra Lind
units.text: Parcel machines and home delivery in Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Finland. Free delivery over €35; below that, €3.90 to a parcel machine and €5.90 home delivery.

units.author: Kostya Rybin
units.text: Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank links for the Baltics. Pay-later to explore.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text: Packaging artwork final by early April, production in April, shop live late April. Agency fee €62,000 in three instalments (kickoff, artwork sign-off, launch). Production, media and fulfilment costs sit with Kelpwise.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text: Okay, I think everyone is here. Agenda: front of pack, back of pack status, the film test results from Ilya, then dates. Dasha, do you want to start?

units.author: Dasha Belova
units.text:
Yes. So, on screen you see all four fronts side by side. The structure is the same on every bag: the logo top left, small, because the shelf tests showed people find the brand by colour, not by the name. Then the flavour band across the middle — that is the coloured strip with the flavour name in English and Estonian. Under it the window, which is now oval, not round, because the round one showed too much of the zip from the inside. At the bottom, one claim line and the weight.

Colours: Sea Salt is the deep green, Chili Lime is the lime, Smoked Paprika is a rusty orange, Wasabi is a pale grey-green. We tested them in the supermarket lighting at the Saue shop, Ilya took photos, the grey-green was a bit weak so I pushed it darker.

The claim line is placeholder text for now. I put "Ocean-grown in Estonia" on all four just to see the length.

units.author: Petra Lind
units.text: The oval window is much better. And the orange is great, very warm.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text: Maren, the main thing we need today is whether we are good on the front. Dasha needs a yes to move on to the final files.

units.author: Maren Holt
units.text:
Let me go through it properly, because I have notes from the weekend.

First, thank you, Dasha. This is the first time I look at the bags and think they belong next to the imported brands. The colour of the Sea Salt bag is exactly what I hoped for. The logo size — I was worried it is too small, but I tried it on the shelf photo and you are right, the colour does the work.

Two small things on the visual side. The weight at the bottom is too close to the edge, on the real bag the bottom gusset folds and it will disappear. And the Estonian flavour name on Smoked Paprika breaks into two lines, I would rather make the band a little taller than break the word. On Wasabi the grey-green is better than in the first round, but next to the Sea Salt bag it still looks a little washed out under the shop lights, so please try one more step darker and print a sample on the real film, not on paper. And the oval window: I like it, but check that the sheets inside do not slide down and leave the window half empty after the bag has been on a truck for a day. Ilya can give you a few bags that came back from the Tartu shop, they show what happens after transport.

Now the decision. The layout I approve: logo, flavour band, oval window, the order and the colours — go ahead with that. The words on the front are not approved. The claim line and the flavour descriptions are still with Liisa at the law firm, and "ocean-grown" may not be allowed as a claim at all, so nothing with text goes to final files until she replies.

Is that clear enough for you?

units.author: Dasha Belova
units.text: Yes, clear. Layout yes, text waits for Liisa.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text: Good. Back of pack: layout is ready, all text is placeholder, same reason. We will show it once Liisa is done. Ilya, the film?

units.author: Ilya Sorokin
units.text:
Yes. I will start with the good news. The storage test for the sheets themselves is finished: in the current bag and in the samples, the taste is fine for the whole period we can promise, and the colour stays green, which was my worry with the paprika. The salt level is the new one, 2.1 grams, and the label text follows that. The lab report is in the shared folder, with the photos from every week.

The humidity cabinet: we kept ten filled bags of each sample at 40% and at 75% humidity for four weeks, with the zip closed, and every week we opened one and checked crispness on the scale the lab gave us. The mono laminate from Nordflex was perfect all four weeks. The second sample, the paper-based one, was soft after two weeks at 75%, so that one is out.

And NatureLam. The film itself keeps moisture out well, but the seal is the problem: at 40% humidity three of ten bags opened along the side seal inside the box, before anyone touched them. Their technician came on Friday and thinks it is the sealing temperature on our machine, but we cannot change the machine before May. So for the first run we go with the recyclable mono-PE laminate from Nordflex; the compostable film comes back in the autumn reorder if the seal problem is solved.

The recycling mark on the back changes, Dasha, I will send you the right symbol and text. And the lab wants the next batch of bags from the first real run for a second storage test, so please, Owen, keep twenty bags from the first pallet aside, do not send them to the fair. They need them by the end of May, the test takes eight weeks, and the result goes into the file for the Finnish chain, who asked for it in writing.

units.author: Petra Lind
units.text: That is a shame for the story, but a bag that opens in the box is worse. We keep "recyclable" on the back then?

units.author: Ilya Sorokin
units.text: Yes, recyclable, with the correct mark. I will send it today.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text: Dates then. Artwork final for the text parts depends on Liisa. Everything else we can have by Friday. The shop is on track, the port to the new platform is about two thirds done.

units.author: Maren Holt
units.text: Good. I will call Liisa myself this afternoon.

units.author: Tim Varga
units.text: I think we are mostly aligned. Anything else before dates?

units.author: Nell Okafor
units.text: Can we keep the next one to thirty minutes? I have a call with the bank at eleven.

units.author: Petra Lind
units.text: One question from me: are the Finnish texts going on the same bag or a separate sticker? I think a sticker for now, until we know the Finnish chain says yes.

units.author: Owen Fairley
units.text: For the Helsinki fair we need sample bags in the new design. Even ten would help, hand-made is fine.
